selectionPolicy.basis: 250 additional completed pairs toward 750, in ten 25-pair releases. Ordered selection is a research queue, not an assertion that 250 references qualify. Assessment included living canonical/regional breeds, exact varieties, crossbreeds and historical types. Historical reconstruction, known synonyms, ambiguous parent substitution and existing holds remain excluded. Every exact identity, source chain, original and researched claim must qualify before any generation call. Genuine blocks require append-only evidence and the next eligible reserve; no attempt, packet, held identity or draft counts toward completion.

knownPreFreezeExclusions.reason: French Brittany aliases published Brittany0200238; no distinct lineage established.
American Cockapoo overlaps generic Cockapoo until distinct subtype eligibility is established.
Coydog is a coyote hybrid, outside this living dog morphology continuation.
ASCOB shorthand duplicates exact American Cocker ASCOB0200039.

selectionPolicy.amendmentPolicy: Preserve frozen identity/order, record dated genuine blocks with evidence, and activate next eligible ordered reserve through a hash-chained append-only amendment. No silent substitution.

VBO:0200484.reason: Exact Commons search returned no files. A registry list names English Bullador, but no reviewed exact parentage and behavior account or adult original was established. It remains unqualified rather than being counted as a duplicate parent.

reference.visualReview: Full mature American Cocker in standing side pose. Round head, short deep muzzle, long feathered ears, compact body and grounded legs readable; considerable show coat partly veils joints. A short docked feathered tail is complete within frame. Handler/show environment is reference context only. Generate a new moderately coated dog with a complete natural tail under the Royal Kennel Club standard; do not transfer show styling, handler or source setting.

sources.title: FCI American Cocker Spaniel standard
sources.evidence: FCI 167 utilization: flushing dog and companion. General appearance requires a free, merry dog with keen inclination to work and considerable speed and endurance. Temperament: equable. Colour section defines parti-colour as two or more solid colours, one white, including black-white, red-white, brown-white and roans. Claims apply to the breed, not a purported colour personality.

attempts.prompt:
COMPOSITION FIRST: pull the camera back so the ENTIRE standing dog occupies about 65–70% of native image height, centered amid visible landscape, with comfortable open space above ears and below all paws and broad side margins beyond nose and complete tail.
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium StackRank Dogs field-guide portrait. Generate exactly ONE finished image, native 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 landscape.
Input is the exact adult Ori Pei morphology reference ONLY. Create a wholly NEW individual, pose, composition, lighting and background. Do not recreate the source photograph.
Scene: A quiet North American woodland park path on a mild early-autumn morning, soft maple leaves distant behind clean dry earth, gentle open shade.
Subject: A mature Ori-Pei reflecting the exact four-year-old male reference: compact nearly square sturdy body, short smooth fawn coat, broad black muzzle shorter than a Shar-Pei but with adult substance, dark round eyes, small natural folded ears and moderate forehead/neck folds. Strong proportionate legs visibly longer than a Pug’s, coherent joints and four separate compact grounded paws. Complete natural tightly curled tail above rump with attachment and full curve readable; moderate adult wrinkles, no exaggerated skin folds, no puppy proportions.
Composition: exactly one adult dog standing in relaxed open three-quarter view at dog-eye height, body slightly angled and head gently turned toward camera. Four separate anatomically coherent grounded paws and ENTIRE visible natural tail from attachment to tip. Maintain generous crop-safe margins, distinct leg/joint separation, natural weight and credible ground contact.
Style: exceptional photorealistic editorial field photography, tactile breed-specific coat texture, restrained natural color, coherent soft daylight and quiet observational character.
Avoid: people, other animals, game, livestock, collar, lead, harness, wardrobe, text, logo, watermark, clipped ears/paws/tail, duplicate or fused limbs, extra toes, plastic fur, painted texture, show floor, indoor source background, or source-photo composition.
